name: Raheem Residency
location: Beach Road, Alappuzha — an 1868 colonial bungalow, 50m from Alleppey Beach
why_special: An 1868 colonial property restored in 2003 and recognised by the Government of India as a genuine Heritage Hotel. Just 10 rosewood-and-teak rooms around a courtyard pool, a sea-view spa and the Chakara restaurant — the most characterful address in Alleppey town itself, away from the houseboat jetty crush.

name: Lake Palace Resort, Alleppey
location: Punnamada, Alappuzha — on the banks of Punnamada Lake, on the Vembanad backwaters
why_special: A backwater resort on Punnamada Lake — the lake that hosts the Nehru Trophy snake-boat race — with pool, spa and waterfront villas opening onto the canals. A land-based alternative to the houseboat for travellers who want the backwater setting with a fixed base.

name: Alleppey Prince Hotel
location: A.S. Road, NH-66, Alappuzha — central town, near the boat jetty and railway station
why_special: A long-running 42-room 4-star on the highway through Alappuzha town — indoor pool, restaurant, coffee shop and a reliable mid-range standard. The practical pick for travellers who want a town base within easy reach of the houseboat jetty and the beach.

name: Rainforest Resort, Athirapally
location: Athirappilly — on the edge of the Sholayar Forest Reserve, overlooking Athirapally Falls
why_special: A nine-room boutique resort built on terraces at the forest edge, with floor-to-ceiling windows framing the Athirapally Falls themselves. Guided treks to the foot of the falls and walking safaris through the Sholayar range — the closest serious property to the waterfall.

name: Sterling Athirappilly
location: Kallana, Vettilappara — on the banks of the Chalakudy River, 25 mi from Cochin airport
why_special: A 30-room contemporary resort on the Chalakudy riverbank with sweeping views toward the falls — outdoor pool, river-view restaurant, river fishing and bird-watching. The reliable mid-to-upper family option from the Sterling Holidays chain.

name: Athirapilly River Resort
location: Chalakudy, Thrissur district — along the Chalakudy River, a short drive from Athirapally Falls
why_special: A small nine-room river-facing resort near Chalakudy town with river bathing, campfires and nature walks — Tripadvisor's #1 inn in Athirappilly. The value pick for the falls without paying boutique-resort rates.

name: Taj Bekal Resort & Spa
location: Kappil, Bekal — 26 acres of backwater and beachfront, 1640 ft from Kappil Beach
why_special: A 5-star spread over 26 acres of backwater and beach, with 71 villas whose architecture is modelled on Kettuvallam houseboats — Chitra Pothi murals, plunge pools, the J Wellness Circle for Ayurveda and three restaurants. One of South India's finest resort settings.

name: Bekal Fort Heritage Homestay (Chandralayam)
location: Bekal, Kasaragod district — a century-old Kerala house in coconut plantations near Bekal Fort
why_special: A 100-year-old traditional Kerala house, formerly called Chandralayam, cocooned in coconut groves a short distance from Bekal Fort. Family-run by Anoop and his team, with home-cooked Kerala meals — the honest heritage-homestay alternative to the resort strip.

name: Chengod Heritage Home Stay
location: Kozhikode region near Beypore — a traditional Kerala heritage tharavad home
why_special: A traditional Kerala heritage home in the Kozhikode area near the Beypore shipyard — the one verifiable heritage-character stay in a destination that otherwise leans on city hotels in Kozhikode proper.

name: Cherai Beach Resorts
location: Cherai Beach, Vypin Island, Kochi — between the Arabian Sea and the backwaters, 25km from Cochin airport
why_special: Cherai's namesake resort, set where the Arabian Sea meets the backwaters on Vypin Island — Ayurvedic spa, pool and beachfront rooms at the gateway to the Muziris heritage zone. The established mid-to-upper anchor for the beach.

name: Les 3 Elephants
location: Cherai Beach, Vypin Island, Kochi — on the backwaters, 150m from the beach
why_special: A French-Indian-owned boutique eco resort on the backwaters — thatched bungalows with backwater-facing sit-outs, organic Kudumbashree-sourced produce, a daily-changing French/Kerala menu and natural ayurveda toiletries. The distinctive xfactor stay at Cherai.

name: Thoovanam Log House (Kerala Forest Department)
location: Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary, Marayoor — a solar log house near Thoovanam Falls, deep-forest facing
why_special: A fully solar-electrified log house run by the Kerala Forest Department's eco-tourism programme, facing deep forest near Thoovanam Falls. Reporting is at the Alampetty eco-shop at 3pm; rate includes Forest Department watchers, cook and guide. The only fixed accommodation inside Chinnar.

name: Chinnar Treetop Machans (Kerala Forest Department)
location: Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary, Marayoor — furnished tree huts at Koottar/Karakkad
why_special: Forest Department machans (tree huts) built on single trees at Koottar and Karakkad, furnished and supplied with water and solar power, giving an aerial view over the dry-deciduous forest. Booked through the Alampetty/Chinnar eco-shops.

name: Krishna Inn
location: East Nada, Guruvayur — a 10-minute walk from the Sree Krishna Temple
why_special: A reliable 69-room hotel a short walk from the temple's east gopuram — free buffet breakfast, multi-cuisine restaurant and self parking. A well-rated, pilgrim-focused base that is markedly more comfortable than the devaswom rest houses.

name: Sopanam Heritage
location: Chavakkad, Guruvayur — a 15-minute walk from the Sree Krishna Temple, with garden and pool
why_special: A heritage-styled hotel with an outdoor pool and lush garden within walking distance of the temple — two restaurants, a cafe and lounges. The most resort-like address in an otherwise functional pilgrim town.

name: Kousthubham Rest House (Guruvayur Devaswom)
location: Guruvayur — a devaswom-run rest house adjacent to the sathram building, beside the temple
why_special: One of the Guruvayur Devaswom's official pilgrim rest houses, immediately beside the temple complex. Plain, inexpensive temple-trust accommodation booked through the devaswom administrator — the authentic pilgrim option.

name: Costa Malabari
location: Thottada, Kannur — a former cashew warehouse turned beach guesthouse near Thottada/Adi Kadalayi beach
why_special: A long-running, much-loved guesthouse near Thottada Beach in a converted cashew warehouse — handloom-rich rooms, home-cooked Malabar seafood and direct access to a quiet, near-empty beach. The original Kannur slow-travel address.

name: The Malabar Beach Resort & Ayurvedic Spa
location: Kannur — a sea-view resort about 10 minutes' drive from Ezhara Beach
why_special: A small sea-view resort with nine rooms near Ezhara Beach — Ayurvedic therapies, yoga and meditation, plus Kalarippayattu performances. A comfortable, wellness-focused base for the Kannur coast.

name: Thottada Beach House
location: Thottada, Kannur — a beach homestay with private access to the 5km Thottada/Ezhara coastline
why_special: A friendly beach homestay with private access to the long, quiet Thottada beach — known for generous, well-rated Malabar seafood and a relaxed, family-run feel. A genuine value alternative on the Kannur coast.

name: Brunton Boatyard — CGH Earth
location: Fort Kochi — on the harbour, beside the Chinese fishing nets
why_special: A CGH Earth heritage hotel on the site of George Brunton's century-old boatyard — all 26 rooms overlook the harbour, with private patios and English-Portuguese-Dutch interiors. The Armoury Cafe revives Anglo-Indian Fort Kochi recipes. The flagship heritage address in old Cochin.

name: Old Harbour Hotel
location: Fort Kochi — a 300-year-old Dutch-Portuguese building near the Chinese fishing nets
why_special: A 300-year-old Dutch-style building, the first hotel of old Cochin, reopened as a boutique heritage hotel a stone's throw from the waterfront and the Chinese fishing nets. Period architecture with a courtyard garden — the most atmospheric mid-luxury stay in Fort Kochi.

name: Old Lighthouse Bristow Hotel
location: Fort Kochi — on Fort Kochi beach, the restored 1927-28 Bristow House and lighthouse mast
why_special: Fort Kochi's only sea-view heritage hotel — the restored 1927-28 Bristow House and lighthouse mast built by Sir Robert Bristow, the engineer of modern Cochin port. Sunset views over the Arabian Sea, a spa and a pool, right on the beach.

name: Fragrant Nature Kollam
location: Paravur, Kollam — a 4-star lake-view resort on Paravur Lake, linked to the Ashtamudi backwaters
why_special: A 4-star backwater resort on Paravur Lake at the edge of the Ashtamudi ecosystem — lake-view rooms with private terraces, private pool villas, a spa, rooftop dining and complimentary backwater boat rides. The standout luxury stay in the Kollam area.

name: KTDC Yatri Nivas Kollam (Ashramam)
location: Ashramam, Kollam — a backwater-front KTDC guesthouse on a 200-year-old Guest House campus
why_special: The Kerala Tourism (KTDC) guesthouse at the Ashramam Picnic Village, on a 200-year-old colonial Guest House campus on the Ashtamudi backwater front, with a boat club and adventure park alongside. Plain, inexpensive, government-run — the dependable budget anchor for Kollam.

name: The Island Homestay, Munroe Island
location: Munroe Island, Kollam — a 125-year-old home on an island in Ashtamudi Lake, 27km from Kollam
why_special: A 125-year-old home on Munroe Island, the largest island in Ashtamudi Lake — rustic Kerala village life, canoe rides through narrow canals and home-cooked food. The distinctive backwater-island experience of the Kollam region.

name: The Leela Kovalam, A Raviz Hotel
location: Kovalam — a 67-acre clifftop estate above the Arabian Sea, incorporating Halcyon Castle
why_special: India's only clifftop 5-star resort, spread over 67 acres and built around Halcyon Castle, once the Travancore kings' summer residence. Private beach, sea-facing infinity pool and dramatic cliff-edge views — the headline luxury address at Kovalam.

name: Niraamaya Retreats Surya Samudra
location: Pulinkudi, Kovalam — cliff-edge heritage cottages above the Arabian Sea, south of Kovalam
why_special: A 5-star Ayurvedic wellness resort perched on a cliff edge, with traditional transplanted Keralite heritage cottages shaded by coconut palms. Holistic programmes integrating Ayurveda, yoga and modern wellness — Kovalam's standout wellness retreat.

name: KTDC Samudra Beach Resort, Kovalam
location: Samudra Beach, Kovalam — a 184-room beachfront KTDC resort, the first hotel built at Kovalam
why_special: The Kerala Tourism (KTDC) beachfront resort on Samudra Beach — built by the Queen of Travancore in the 1920s, the first beach resort at Kovalam. Sea-facing rooms, a lawn running to the sand and a Santhigiri Ayurveda centre. The dependable government-run value anchor.

name: The Gateway Hotel Beach Road, Calicut (Taj)
location: Beach Road, Kozhikode — a 5-star Taj Gateway steps from Kozhikode Beach
why_special: A Taj Gateway on Kozhikode's Beach Road — 74 rooms with old-world Kerala charm, an outdoor pool and an Ayurveda wellness centre, a short walk from the beach and the railway station. The headline upscale address in the city.

name: The Raviz Calicut
location: Mavoor Road, Kozhikode — a city-centre 5-star near the railway station and markets
why_special: Kozhikode's central 5-star on Mavoor Road — spacious rooms, two restaurants, a spa and a poolside bar, close to the railway station, markets and malls. The convenient city-centre alternative to the beachfront Gateway.

name: Harivihar Heritage Homestead
location: Bilathikkulam, Kozhikode — a 19th-century ancestral home of a Kadathanad royal family, with Ayurveda
why_special: A 150-year-old ancestral home of a branch of the Kadathanad royal family, run as a heritage Ayurveda homestead — a temple tank for swimming, classical-arts evenings and authentic Ayurveda treatments. The most distinctive heritage stay in Kozhikode.

name: Kumarakom Lake Resort
location: Kumarakom — a heritage backwater resort on the shores of Vembanad Lake, Kottayam district
why_special: Often cited among India's best resorts — meandering pool villas, an Ayurvedic spa and three restaurants, set on Vembanad Lake. Built around transplanted heritage Kerala homes, it is the gold-standard luxury address in Kumarakom.

name: Taj Kumarakom Resort & Spa
location: Kumarakom — 15 acres on Vembanad Lake, around an 1881 missionary's bungalow, by the bird sanctuary
why_special: A 5-star on 15 acres of Vembanad lakefront, built around an 1881 English missionary's bungalow alongside the Kumarakom bird sanctuary — 28 villas and cottages, the J Wellness Circle, kayaking and village cycling tours.

name: Coconut Lagoon — CGH Earth
location: Kumarakom — a boat-access-only heritage eco-resort on Vembanad Lake, by Kavanattinkara
why_special: A CGH Earth eco-resort reachable only by boat, built from transplanted heritage tharavad homes on Vembanad Lake — a 150-year-old traditional house at its heart, organic Kerala cuisine and a strong sustainability ethos. The nature-led luxury option at Kumarakom.

name: Kallancherry Retreat
location: Kumbalangi, Kochi — a 3-acre backwater-surrounded homestay in the model fishing village, 12km from Kochi
why_special: A backwater-surrounded homestay on 3 acres in Kumbalangi, India's first model tourism village — family, river and stilt cottages plus homestay rooms, with insight into the fishing-village way of life. A KTDC Diamond-category homestay.

name: Gramam Homestay (Neduveli House)
location: Kumbalangi, Kochi — a backwater-facing village homestay 10km from Cochin
why_special: A backwater-facing village homestay in Kumbalangi's model fishing village — sunset canoe trips, prawn-farm visits and boat tours of village life. An authentic, low-key fishing-village stay close to Kochi.

name: Philipkutty's Farm
location: Pallam, Kuttanad — waterfront villas on a private reclaimed farm island in Vembanad Lake
why_special: Seven independent waterfront cottages run by a family on a private island reclaimed from Vembanad Lake in the 1950s — communal home-cooked Kuttanad feasts, farm tours and traditional-boat backwater rides. A celebrated, much-awarded backwater homestay.

name: Paloma Backwater Resorts
location: Kainakary, Kuttanad — amid paddy fields and coconut groves in Kuttanad taluk, Alappuzha district
why_special: A backwater resort set among the lush paddy fields and coconut groves of Kainakary, in the heart of Kuttanad's below-sea-level rice country — a genuine, well-listed property in a region thin on fixed accommodation.

name: Marari Beach Resort — CGH Earth
location: Mararikulam, Alappuzha district — a fishing-village-inspired eco-resort on Marari Beach
why_special: CGH Earth's flagship beach eco-resort — thatched-roof villas with private pools or garden views among coconut groves and lotus ponds, on a beach National Geographic rated among the world's top hammock beaches. Cooking demos, backwater cruises and local art.

name: Marari Sands Beach Resort
location: Mararikulam, Alappuzha district — individual cottages and villas with private gardens near Marari Beach
why_special: A premium beach resort of individual cottages and villas, each with a private outdoor garden for sunrise and sunset views, plus an Ayurvedic spa — the most resort-like alternative to the CGH Earth flagship on Marari Beach.

name: Windermere Estate
location: Pothamedu, Munnar — a working cardamom-and-coffee estate around the original Planter's Bungalow
why_special: An intimate 18-room plantation retreat in the Western Ghats, arranged around the original Planter's Bungalow that still serves as the owner's residence. Locally sourced cuisine, an estate boulder for bonfire barbecues and a 4km plantation walk — Munnar's defining estate stay.

name: KTDC Tea County Munnar
location: Munnar — a premium KTDC hill resort set between two hills amid tea gardens
why_special: The Kerala Tourism (KTDC) premium hill resort and 'official host' in Munnar — cottages set between two hills among fragrant tea gardens, with mist-draped mornings and a central position for the hill station's sights. The dependable government-run anchor.

name: The Tall Trees Munnar
location: Bison Valley Road, Munnar — a secluded forest resort among tall evergreen trees, near Sengulam Dam
why_special: A secluded 4-star nature resort with 25 garden-view rooms nestled among tall evergreen forest in the misty Western Ghats — cottages spread through woodland, with the Hill Spice restaurant. A quiet, tree-canopy alternative to the tea-estate stays.

name: Misty Valley Hill Resort
location: Nelliyampathy, Palakkad district — within the 914-acre Anamada coffee-cardamom-orange estate
why_special: A plantation stay set within the 914-acre Anamada Estate of coffee, cardamom and orange — spectacular Western Ghats views, plantation walks and night safaris for bison and sambar deer. A genuine working-estate experience in a thinly developed hill area.

name: Coffee Valley Resort, Nelliyampathy
location: Nelliyampathy, Palakkad district — cottages nestled in the hills amid a coffee estate
why_special: A well-rated Nelliyampathy resort cosily set amid the misty hills and a coffee estate — jeep safaris, bird-watching, trekking and campfires, with furnished cottages and rooms. A reliable value pick for the Nelliyampathy plateau.

name: KTDC Golden Peak Ponmudi
location: Ponmudi, Thiruvananthapuram district — the KTDC hill resort at the top station, ~61km from Trivandrum
why_special: The Kerala Tourism (KTDC) hill resort at the Ponmudi top station — 15 cottage-style and standard rooms with a restaurant, trekking and private campfires, set among mountain flowers and butterflies. Effectively the only accommodation on the Ponmudi hill itself.

name: Poovar Island Resort
location: Poovar — a boat-access island resort on 25 acres of coconut garden between river and sea
why_special: A boat-access-only island resort on 25 acres of coconut garden where the Neyyar river meets the Arabian Sea — land-based superior rooms plus signature floating cottages afloat on the backwater facing the sea. Tripadvisor's #1 Poovar resort.

name: The Travancore Heritage Beach Resort
location: Chowara, between Kovalam and Poovar — a 15-acre clifftop heritage resort of reassembled Travancore houses
why_special: A heritage resort on 15 acres of coconut garden at Chowara, conceived from 60-100-year-old timber Nalukettu houses dismantled across Travancore and rebuilt on a clifftop above the sea — 90 rooms, four pools and an Ayurveda-and-yoga health club.

name: Travancore Devaswom Board Pilgrim Accommodation, Pampa
location: Pampa, Pathanamthitta district — TDB government guest houses and lodges at the foot of the Sabarimala trek
why_special: The cluster of Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) government guest houses and dormitories at Pampa — the main base before the trek to the shrine, closest to the river crossing and the steps. Spartan but official; booked online through the TDB portal, strictly seasonal (Mandala/Makaravilakku).

name: Travancore Devaswom Board Transit Accommodation, Nilackal
location: Nilackal, Pathanamthitta district — the main parking and transit base for Sabarimala, with TDB dormitories and tented camps
why_special: The Travancore Devaswom Board transit base at Nilackal — the main vehicle parking point, with government dormitories, community halls and seasonal tented camps; shuttle buses run on to Pampa. Spartan transit accommodation, seasonal only.

name: Mukkali Forest Rest House (Kerala Forest Department)
location: Mukkali, Palakkad district — the Forest Department rest house and Information Centre at the Silent Valley gateway
why_special: The Kerala Forest Department rest house at Mukkali, the gateway settlement for Silent Valley National Park — basic but comfortable rooms with an Information Centre, the staging point for the Sairandhri jeep trip into the rainforest. The only fixed accommodation at the park gate.

name: Bommiyampadi Eco-Camp (Kerala Forest Department / Eco-Tourism)
location: Bommiyampadi, Silent Valley buffer, Palakkad district — a forest-front cottage and tented eco-camp
why_special: A Forest Department eco-tourism camp at Bommiyampadi in the Silent Valley buffer — a forest-front cottage and tent accommodation, paired with the Sairandhri programme into the core. Part of the KFD eco-tourism package, the only camp-style stay near the park.

name: Spice Village — CGH Earth
location: Kumily, Thekkady — 52 thatched cottages across 12 acres of spice gardens near Periyar
why_special: A CGH Earth eco-resort of 52 elephant-grass-thatched cottages built in the style of the local Mannan tribe, across 12 acres of spice gardens near the Periyar Tiger Reserve — a pool, an Ayurvedic spa, forest treks and bamboo rafting. The defining Thekkady stay.

name: KTDC Aranya Nivas
location: Thekkady — a premium KTDC jungle lodge inside the Periyar Tiger Reserve, at the lake tourism zone
why_special: The Kerala Tourism (KTDC) premium jungle lodge inside the Periyar Tiger Reserve itself, at the central tourism zone by the lake — a pool, a library on the environment, an Ayurvedic spa and a multi-cuisine restaurant. The only hotel actually inside the reserve.

name: Cardamom County by Xandari
location: Thekkady — a hillside 4-star resort facing the Periyar Tiger Reserve, 2km from Thekkady town
why_special: A hillside 4-star resort of cottages and suites facing the Periyar Tiger Reserve — a pool, butterfly garden, Ayurveda spa and yoga. The reliable mid-to-upper resort pick a short way from the reserve gate.

name: Hyatt Regency Thrissur
location: Thrissur — a city 5-star, 15 minutes from the railway station, near the Vadakkunnathan temple
why_special: Thrissur's headline 5-star in the cultural capital of Kerala — 76 rooms including Regency suites, full city-hotel facilities, well placed for the Thrissur Pooram festival and the Vadakkunnathan temple.

name: Joys Palace Hotel, Thrissur
location: Thrissur — a central 5-star business hotel, near the Arattupuzha temple and the cathedral
why_special: A landmark 5-star business hotel in central Thrissur — 62 smoke-free rooms, a swimming pool, steam room and sauna, well placed for the city's temples and the cathedral. A dependable city base.

name: Vivanta Thiruvananthapuram
location: Thiruvananthapuram — a city-centre 5-star, 5km from Trivandrum airport
why_special: Trivandrum's bold city-centre 5-star where Travancore heritage meets modern design — 108 rooms, the city's only downtown infinity pool, a Kerala-cuisine speciality restaurant and all-day dining. The headline upscale stay in the capital.

name: Oyster Marris Homestays
location: Thiruvallam, Thiruvananthapuram — a women-run sea-facing cliff homestay, 15 minutes from the airport
why_special: A Kerala Tourism Gold-classified, women-owned-and-run homestay on a sea-facing cliff at Thiruvallam — breezy rooms with glimpses of the Arabian Sea, organic Kerala cuisine and wellness options, close to the airport and the Padmanabhaswamy temple.

name: Vanilla County Heritage Plantation Bungalow
location: Vagamon, Idukki district — an 8-room heritage plantation bungalow, near the Marmala Waterfalls
why_special: A heritage plantation bungalow with eight mountain-view rooms about 10 minutes from Vagamon town, near the Marmala Waterfalls — a summer terrace, yoga and spa therapy, warm family hospitality and praised plantation-grown food. The defining Vagamon heritage stay.

name: Saj Vagamon Hideout
location: Vagamon, Idukki district — eco cottages at 3000ft in the Western Ghats
why_special: An eco-resort of cottages built with local materials, set 3000 feet up in the Western Ghats above Vagamon — a quiet, nature-led mid-range base for the meadows, pine forest and paragliding country.

name: Gateway Varkala (Taj)
location: Varkala — a clifftop Taj Gateway on a verdant hillock facing the Arabian Sea
why_special: A Taj Gateway in a prime clifftop position above the Arabian Sea — rooms and suites with spacious sea- or garden-facing balconies, the Coastal Kitchen restaurant and an Ayurveda centre. The headline upscale stay at Varkala.

name: Soul & Surf Kerala
location: Varkala — a surf-and-yoga retreat within walking distance of Varkala Cliff
why_special: A surf-and-yoga retreat that runs morning sessions on the beaches, points and jetties around Varkala, with sunset yoga in a rooftop shala — within walking distance of the cliff yet set apart from the hotel strip. Varkala's defining surf stay.

name: Villa Jacaranda
location: South Cliff, Varkala — a four-room boutique guesthouse 5 minutes from Papanasham Beach
why_special: Varkala's premier boutique guesthouse on the quieter South Cliff — four pastel rooms with blue-railed verandas, a rooftop terrace and a small saltwater pool in a lush garden, 5 minutes from Papanasham Beach. A characterful, low-key alternative to the cliff hotels.

name: Vythiri Resort
location: Vythiri, Wayanad district — a family jungle retreat with treehouses in the Western Ghats rainforest
why_special: A long-running family jungle retreat at Vythiri — treehouses, pool villas, a spa and wellness centre set in rainforest. One of Wayanad's most popular premium resorts and a blueprint for the district's treehouse stays.

name: Vythiri Village Resort (Club Mahindra)
location: Vythiri, Wayanad district — a 30-acre 5-star sanctuary at 2,600ft above sea level
why_special: A 5-star resort on a 30-acre sanctuary at 2,600 feet — luxury rooms and pool villas, an Ayurveda spa, run by Club Mahindra. The most full-facility family-luxury address in the Wayanad highlands.

name: Wayanad Wild — A CGH Earth Experience
location: Vythiri, Wayanad district — a treetop eco-resort within the Western Ghats rainforest
why_special: A CGH Earth eco-resort with rooms on treetops, designed to blend into the dense Western Ghats rainforest around it — an immersive, nature-fused stay rather than a facility resort. The eco-led pick for Wayanad.

name: Edakkal Hermitage
location: Ambalavayal, Wayanad district — cave-themed cottages on a hillside near the Edakkal Caves
why_special: A boutique hillside resort near the prehistoric Edakkal Caves — cottages with a cave-like décor concept, a fireplace and a picnic area, pet-friendly and homely. A distinctive character stay tied to Wayanad's archaeology.
